subject: ISV co-sell & trace SDK pilot — PromptForge connector
messages:
From: Oliver Grant <oliver@promptforge.io>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Sharma <priya@promptforge.io>
Date: Tue, 29 Jun 2027 08:14:00 -0700
Subject: PromptForge x Redwood — trace SDK + LangChain/LlamaIndex connector pilot

Hi Soojin,

Quick intro — I’m Oliver (Head of Partnerships, PromptForge). We’ve built a tracing shim that plugs into popular SDKs (LangChain, LlamaIndex) and surfaces prompt-level telemetry + token footprints to partners like Redwood for co-sell workflows. We think a small pilot could demonstrate clear commercial value: lower troubleshooting time for joint customers, increased lead conversion from co-marketed demos, and a repeatable integration pattern for the marketplace.

High-level ask: would Redwood be open to a 6-week technical pilot where we:
- Integrate our trace shim into Redwood’s dev sandbox,
- Exercise end-to-end flows for LangChain / LlamaIndex sample apps,
- Run 3 joint QA scenarios (latency tracing, token attribution, prompt regressions),
- Produce a Mutual Action Plan + go/no-go for co-sell.

I attached a short brief (PF-trace-integration-brief.pdf) and a sample MAP. If this looks interesting, can we book a 45-min sync next week to map stakeholders and timelines?

Thanks — looking forward to your thoughts.

—Oliver Grant
Head of Partnerships, PromptForge
oliver@promptforge.io | +1 415-555-0198
Attachment: PF-trace-integration-brief.pdf (1 page overview)

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Oliver Grant <oliver@promptforge.io>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Jun 2027 09:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: PromptForge x Redwood — trace SDK + LangChain/LlamaIndex connector pilot

Oliver —

Appreciate the brief and the clear asks. This aligns with our ISV partner cadence for SDK-level integrations. Quick notes from the product side:
- We care about secure key handling (no persisted customer keys in third-party telemetry),
- We’ll need a minimal reproducible demo using LangChain + our hosted API and a way to toggle tracing per-team,
- Success metrics: time-to-reproduce incidents reduced by >=40%, and no more than a 10% CPU overhead in the tracing path.

Vanessa, Marissa — looping you in to vet commercial and GTM (co-sell) implications.

Oliver — 45 minutes next Wednesday (7/7) 11:00–11:45 PT works for us. Can you share a draft Mutual Action Plan and an anonymized data flow diagram ahead of the call? If you have any compliance checklist items (SOC2 artifacts or an SOC2-lite snapshot), please attach.

Talk soon,

—Soojin Lee
Senior Partner Engineer, Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com

Subject: Re: PromptForge x Redwood — trace SDK + LangChain/LlamaIndex connector pilot

Thanks — appreciate the quick reply and the call window.

Attached: PromptForge-MAP.xlsx (mutual action plan draft) and a 1-page compliance snapshot (SOC2 summary). The MAP includes milestones, owners, and a proposed measurement plan (incident repro time and CPU/latency delta).

We’ll prepare a short demo repo that wires our trace shim into an LlamaIndex-based retrieval app against Redwood hosted endpoints; demo will include a toggle to anonymize tokens in traces.

Call confirmed for 2027-07-07 11:00 PT. Invite sent.

—Oliver
Attachment: PromptForge-MAP.xlsx (MAP v0.1)

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Jul 2027 09:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: PromptForge x Redwood — trace SDK + LangChain/LlamaIndex connector pilot

Folks — forwarding Oliver’s brief and MAP. Quick internal checklist before the 7/7 call:

- Commercial: confirm co-sell play: revenue split expectations, lead routing (HubSpot), and whether we list PromptForge as "verified" in our partner catalog. Vanessa — can you advise preferred split ranges and whether Legal needs to pre-seed an MSA amendment?
- Security & Compliance: we should request an architecture diagram showing where token truncation/anonymization occurs and whether any PII crosses their systems. Marissa — can you flag required docs (SOC2 report, data processing addendum) ahead of the call?
- Technical: request an example LangChain flow that demonstrates trace sampling and KV-cache tagging. I want to avoid any tracing path that requires re-tokenization on their side.

Quoted original for context:

> > Quick intro — I’m Oliver (Head of Partnerships, PromptForge). We’ve built a tracing shim that plugs into popular SDKs (LangChain, LlamaIndex) and surfaces prompt-level telemetry + token footprints to partners like Redwood for co-sell workflows.

I’ll draft a short call agenda and share before EOD PST.

—Soojin

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Oliver Grant <oliver@promptforge.io>, Priya Sharma <priya@promptforge.io>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Jul 2027 15:32:00 -07:00
Subject: PromptForge x Redwood — pilot next steps & proposed commercial framework

Oliver / Priya — thanks for the materials and for confirming the call next week. Quick next steps and our proposed commercial outline so we have something concrete to discuss on 7/7: 

1) Pilot scope (technical): 6 weeks, dev sandbox + staging validation, 3 test scenarios (latency trace, token attribution, prompt regression).
2) Commercial: co-sell referral fee for the pilot period (one-time), then revenue-share model for any billed customers (proposed 70/30 Redwood/PromptForge for joint-sourced deals where Redwood provides inference infrastructure). We’re open to discussing placement in the partner catalog and a "verified" badge after successful pilot and security review.
3) Legal / Compliance: we’ll need a DPA + a short addendum to our MSA that covers telemetry retention and data minimization. For the pilot, retention of traces should be limited to 30 days by default.

Please see the attached draft offer that captures the ask above. On the call we’ll confirm owners for each MAP line item and agree on sit-ups for telemetry sampling. If the commercial outline is acceptable in principle, we can ask Legal to spin a pilot SOW after the call.

Calendar: confirmed for 2027-07-07 11:00 PT (45m).

Regards,

—Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0124
Attachment: COSELL_Offer_v1.docx (3 pages, draft commercial terms)
